_note: Copied to index.motion.json by tools/prepare.mjs --motion, which only tier 3 asks for: the motion audit samples ~240 frames and roughly doubles a check run. `before` compares when each element APPEARS, so it can only order entrances that change presence (opacity/autoAlpha). A clip-path reveal leaves the element present the whole time and both sides report the same instant — which is why the icon's bloom is not asserted here and the letters are.
